# devopser_variable (Resource)

A workspace variable (tfe_variable).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "devopser_variable" "region" {
  workspace_id = devopser_workspace.network.id
  key          = "region"
  value        = "us-east-1"
  category     = "terraform"
}

resource "devopser_variable" "api_key" {
  workspace_id = devopser_workspace.network.id
  key          = "API_KEY"
  value        = var.api_key
  category     = "env"
  sensitive    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category` (String) terraform (an input variable) or env (an environment variable).
- `key` (String) Variable name.
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace the variable belongs to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free text shown in the portal.
- `hcl` (Boolean) Parse the value as HCL rather than a string.
- `sensitive` (Boolean) Hide the value in the API and the portal.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Variable value. Write-only when sensitive: the API never returns it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The variable id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <workspace name or id>/<variable id>
tofu import devopser_variable.region network/318
```
